o: A person is working on a laptop.
A person is hanging a picture on the wall.
Some chairs are stacked by the window.
p1.why: Người đang ngồi làm việc với máy tính xách tay. Cây có trong tranh nhưng không ai tưới (is being watered); tranh đã treo sẵn, không ai đang treo.
lines: A. A plant is being watered.
B. A person is working on a laptop.
C. A person is hanging a picture on the wall.
D. Some chairs are stacked by the window.

o: Some bicycles have been parked in a row.
A man is riding a bicycle.
A tree is being cut down.
p1.why: Xe đã được dựng thành hàng (have been parked). Không có người trong tranh nên câu "is riding", "are being repaired" (đang có người sửa) đều sai.
lines: A. Some bicycles have been parked in a row.
B. A man is riding a bicycle.
C. A tree is being cut down.
D. The bicycles are being repaired.

o: A waiter is serving a customer.
p1.why: Đầu bếp đang nấu ăn. Không có khách hay người phục vụ; không ai rửa bát; bếp có người nên không "empty".
lines: A. A waiter is serving a customer.
B. Some dishes are being washed.
C. A cook is preparing food.

o: Two people are sitting at a table.
A man is making a phone call.
p1.why: Hai người đang bắt tay. Họ đứng, không ngồi; không gọi điện; "exchanging business cards" là bẫy hay gặp khi tranh có hai người gặp nhau.
lines: A. Two people are sitting at a table.
B. A man is making a phone call.
C. They are exchanging business cards.
D. Two people are shaking hands.

o: Boxes have been arranged on the shelves.
A worker is opening a box.
Boxes are being loaded onto a truck.
p1.why: Thùng đã được xếp lên kệ (have been arranged). Không có người nên "is opening", "are being loaded" sai; kệ có thùng nên không "empty".
lines: A. Boxes have been arranged on the shelves.
B. A worker is opening a box.
D. Boxes are being loaded onto a truck.

o: People are swimming in the water.
Some boats are floating near a pier.
p1.why: Thuyền nổi trên mặt nước gần cầu tàu (pier). Không có người bơi hay sơn thuyền; cầu tàu không phải cây cầu bắc qua sông (bridge).
lines: A. People are swimming in the water.
B. Some boats are floating near a pier.
C. A boat is being painted.
D. A bridge crosses the river.

o: A woman is writing a letter.
A woman is standing in front of a board.
p1.why: Người phụ nữ đứng trước bảng. Không có học sinh; ghế đặt trên sàn, không ai đang chồng ghế (are being stacked).
lines: A. A woman is writing a letter.
B. Students are leaving the room.
C. A woman is standing in front of a board.

o: People are waiting at a bus stop.
Passengers are getting off a train.
The road is closed to traffic.
p1.why: Hai người đứng chờ ở trạm xe buýt. Không ai sửa xe; tranh không có tàu hoả (train); đường có xe chạy nên không "closed".
lines: A. People are waiting at a bus stop.
B. A bus is being repaired.
C. Passengers are getting off a train.
D. The road is closed to traffic.

o: A table has been set for a meal.
p1.why: Bàn đã được bày sẵn đĩa, ly (has been set). Không có người nên không ai đang ăn, rót đồ uống hay rửa đĩa.
lines: A. Some people are eating dinner.
B. A waiter is pouring drinks.
C. The plates are being washed.
D. A table has been set for a meal.

o: A worker is carrying a ladder.
A worker is standing on a ladder.
A wall is being knocked down.
Some tools have been left on a chair.
p1.why: Người thợ đứng trên thang. "Carrying a ladder" là bẫy (có thang nhưng không mang vác); hộp dụng cụ ở dưới sàn, không trên ghế.
lines: A. A worker is carrying a ladder.
B. A worker is standing on a ladder.

o: A person is sitting on a bench.
A person is running along a path.
p1.why: Một người đang chạy trên lối đi. Không có ghế đá; đài phun nước đã có sẵn, không ai đang lắp (is being installed); không ai quét lá.

B. A fountain is being installed.
C. A person is running along a path.
D. Some leaves are being swept.

o: A shopper is paying at the register.
A cart is being pushed out of a store.

p1.why: Trong xe đẩy đã có hàng (have been placed). Không có người nên không ai trả tiền, xếp hàng lên kệ (are being stocked) hay đẩy xe.

docs.text: Beginning on Monday, May 5, the Oakdale Public Library will open at 8:00 A.M. on weekdays, one hour earlier than before. [1] The change follows a survey in which many residents said they would like to visit the library before work. [2] Weekend hours will stay the same. [3] During the first week of the new schedule, staff will be at the front desk from 8:00 A.M. to help visitors set up online accounts, which can be used to reserve books and study rooms. [4] For more information, call 555-0172 or visit our Web site.

docs.text: WESTBROOK (October 2) — Greenline Bikes, a bicycle rental company founded in Westbrook four years ago, will open stations in two more cities next spring. [1] The company currently runs 60 stations across Westbrook, where riders unlock bikes with a mobile app and pay by the minute. [2] According to chief executive Hana Sato, the expansion was made possible by a new agreement with the regional train operator. [3] Under the agreement, Greenline stations will be placed outside every major train station, and train passengers will receive a 20 percent discount on rides. [4] Ms. Sato said the company also plans to add electric bikes to its fleet by the end of next year.
